events.evidence: U.S. president Donald Trump says that the U.S. military will not attack Iran before the midterm elections next month
The Taiwanese finance ministry reports that exports reached a record US$87.2 billion in September
Russian forces launch a ballistic missile attack on two buses in the city of Kramatorsk in Ukraine, killing at least 30 people, while 18 others are wounded

label.note: Iran attack pause and record Taiwan exports support risk, offset by deadly Ukraine missile strike.
